models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description: Temporary guest accounts identified by device fingerprint for anonymous access to public endpoints. Guests are unauthenticated visitors who can access public endpoints like registration and login without requiring credentials. Each guest account can have multiple sessions tracked in {@link multi_user_todo_guest_sessions}.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the guest's device used for anonymous access tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access with short expiration. Tracks anonymous user sessions for public endpoint access. Each session belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_guests} and includes access metadata for security auditing.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL when session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for session origin tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic invalidation.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description: Registered member accounts with email and password hash for authentication. Display names are stored in {@link multi_user_todo_user_profiles}. Each member owns private todos and can manage their profile, sessions, and account lifecycle.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last account update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deletion tracking.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access and refresh token support for member authentication. Tracks login sessions for authenticated members with expiration management. Each session belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_members} and is append-only for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address at session creation.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page URL at session creation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL at session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration for member password recovery. Each token is single-use and expires after a short period for security. Tokens are generated when members request password reset and verified during the password change flow.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token for verification. Generated as a secure random string.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp for security. Tokens become invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for member registration and email confirmation. Stores temporary verification codes sent to users during account creation or email change processes. Each token is unique and expires after a set period. Tracks verification status and timestamps for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token sent via email for account activation or email confirmation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address being verified during registration or email change.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified or expired.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted.

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_profiles
models.description: User profile data including display names, separate from authentication accounts. Each profile belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_members} and stores the user's public display name. Managed through the member entity lifecycle.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's public display name shown in the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description:
Task tracking entities with title, description, optional dates, completion status, and soft delete support.

Each todo belongs to exactly one member and can be toggled between complete and incomplete states. Todos support soft deletion for trash functionality, allowing users to restore or permanently delete them. Edit history is tracked separately in {@link multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title (required).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Todo description (optional).

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Optional start date.

plainFields.name: due_at
plainFields.description: Optional due date.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Completion timestamp. Null means incomplete, non-null means complete.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for trash functionality. Null means active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories
models.description: Audit trail recording all modifications to todos including timestamps and changed field values. Each entry captures the new values of fields that were modified during an edit operation. Belongs to {@link multi_user_todo_todos} and is cascade deleted when the parent todo is permanently removed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit was made.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: New title value if the title was changed during this edit, otherwise null.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: New description value if the description was changed during this edit, otherwise null.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: New start date value if the start date was changed during this edit, otherwise null.

plainFields.name: due_at
plainFields.description: New due date value if the due date was changed during this edit, otherwise null.
